ProjectionNotes: Source/Sequence indexes the merged one-based Observations array; EvidenceComponent/NativeSequence preserve original calls, including cleanup and transient role-propagation failures.
Only header/control evidence: no physical expiration, noncurrent version deletion, MPU abortion, transition delivery, or AWS scheduling SLA is inferred.

Fresh owned resources only. Verified IAM user Delegated identity; never treated native user as root. Existing member OrganizationAccountAccessRole was assumed, not modified. All seven buckets and one role independently verified absent.

Exact 23-byte binary payload is retained in Payload and each successful GET DownloadedBody, not inferred from input strings. Explicit --body file and explicit GetObject bucket/key/outfile plus ChecksumMode=ENABLED were used.

Original run stopped on a harness KeyError after suspended null PUT correctly omitted VersionId. Every owned resource was cleaned. Continuation explicitly requested null and completed the remaining suspended and authority cases.

Escaped rule ID usually appears a b%22&,/%25%c3%a9, preserving literal spaces, ampersand, comma and slash. One original GET returned literal quote/percent/non-ASCII on the actual wire. Six supplemental HEAD/GET pairs returned encoded form. This is retained variability, not SDK decoding or a claimed universal escaping algorithm.
Enabled explicit current VersionId and suspended explicit null requests omit Expiration even while implicit latest requests expose it. Noncurrent and delete-marker reads also omit it.

Days uses last-modified date plus Days then next UTC midnight; Date uses its fixed midnight. Minimum deadline wins different-day overlaps. Equal deadline chose tie-last under both input orders; no universal tie-break algorithm is claimed.

Every sampled absence has a successful same-object/header or matching-object positive control in that scenario. IAM role propagation refusals precede successful identity/data controls and are not projected as stable denials.

Cross-account GET/PUT/DELETE lifecycle controls succeeded with member identity authority and an owned-bucket policy grant; absence of the grant denied all three. Stateful supplement positively observed the member rule before deletion, then NoSuchLifecycleConfiguration and absent header. The earlier immediate owner read after rapid PUT/DELETE returned the prior rule and is retained only as a propagation sample.

Immediate HeadBucket after successful deletion of the final cross-account bucket still returned 200; independent later 404 confirmed absence. Both deletion-propagation samples are retained in component cleanup observations.
Scenarios use existing s3ObjectCall/s3KMSCall schema. All real resources, sessions, upload IDs and version IDs use existing Bind/Session machinery; no framework changes.

Native owner user normalizes to local caller root for fixture setup only. Fresh assumed roles retain captured session-policy restrictions. This does not claim root-like native user behavior. The existing member role is reconstructed locally under other with broad S3 identity permission; captured bucket-policy authorization remains unchanged.
Native automatic upload CRC64NVME checksums are explicit ChecksumAlgorithm=CRC64NVME on PutObject and UploadPart. Native explicit GET ChecksumMode=ENABLED is retained.

Manual At instants preserve native UTC dates. Reopen occurs after configuration installation/removal and between version-state mutations and reads. No Drain or artificial future scheduler execution is introduced.

The one literal escaped-days-get expiration outlier is evidence-only for that field: this row still checks binary body and all remaining metadata. Six repeat pairs remain in evidence and one encoded pair is projected. Exact native expiration strings remain fully retained in evidence.

Equal-deadline tie observations remain evidence-only for rule-id. Projection compares no Expiration field/header for those two reads because no deterministic tie contract was established. Different-deadline overlaps remain exact.

CompleteMultipartUpload endpoint Location is retained only in evidence; other output fields/checksums/body are asserted. CLI diagnostic error messages are retained but replay compares wire Code rather than unstable wording.
Limitations: No repository build/tests/formatting run by evidence worker; Main owns integration entrypoints and final validation.

Existing runner has no accepted-one-of-header assertion or intrinsic next-UTC-midnight binding. Fixed native-day manual At plus exact header assertions exercise date arithmetic; observed escaping and tie variability are documented rather than adding another framework.
